string.text: Intercepted transmission
...the Monolith has spoken a name over %map%. Brothers, before the hour turns, we answer.
...a heretic walks in %map%, carrying his little life like a lamp. We will put it out.
...pray, brothers. One hour of prayer, then the pilgrimage. Our road is %map%.
...%name%. The stone whispers it now. It wants him brought to the light.
...do not fear his guns. Whoever dies for the Monolith does not die.
...the unbeliever runs from the heart of the Zone. We are the heart of the Zone. %map%.
...the light showed me his face in my sleep. I will know him at %map%.
...gather the chosen. The Monolith asks for a sacrifice before dawn. %map%.
...he killed our brothers. They are with the Monolith now. He will join them.
...the voice grows louder, brothers. It says: within the hour.
...no mercy for him, no prayer. Only the light. %map%.
...glory to the Monolith. The stray at %map% will kneel, or he will burn.
...Overwatch, confirm: subject %name%, area %map%. Clean extraction, or none.
...protocol nine. No witnesses. Anyone near the subject is part of the subject.
...teleport window in sixty minutes. Coordinates locked: %map%.
...this conversation does not exist. By morning, neither will he.
...field team, scrub every trace. The institute was never in %map%.
...the subject has seen too much. Containment is authorised.
...beacon signature is fresh, area %map%. Team two, coils to full charge.
...if the stalkers ask, it was an anomaly. It is always an anomaly.
...he has slipped us before. Not again. Double team, suppressed weapons.
...encrypt, then burn after reading. Target: %map%. Window: one hour.
...his file already says 'deceased'. Make it accurate.
...no radio after this. We arrive, we finish, we were never there.
...Command to all callsigns: target located, sector %map%. Shoot on sight.
...no arrests, no questions. Come back with a body or don't come back.
...grid confirmed: %map%. The teleport team loads in one hour.
...the stalker %name% is on the colonel's list. Nobody on that list survives.
...civilians in the area? There are no civilians in the Zone. Fire at will.
...the institute's teleporter is ours again tonight. Move fast.
...he has our boys' blood on him. Take your time with him.
...Granite-6, you have the lead. Flush him into the open, the rest is easy.
...repeat: the target is armed. So are we. And there are more of us.
...the order is signed. %map%, one hour, full kit.
...if he hides behind the traders' walls, we wait. The Zone is patient. So are we.
...this is Sector Command. Radio silence from now on. Next report: target down.
A cold feeling at the back of your neck. Someone has your scent.
It's in your head now: they know your face, your walk, your smell.
The watched feeling fades. For now.
The Monolith's voices keep naming one place: %map%. The faithful are gathering here.
Encrypted traffic, institute codes: %map% is now their operation area.
Military net: sector %map% is cleared for raids. Anyone in it is a target.
The chatter about %map% has died down. They have lost your trail here.
